The '''Andobi Mountain Pipeline''' was a pipeline and pump system that brought spring [[Water/Legends|water]] from the [[Andobi Mountains/Legends|Andobi Mountains]] to the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]].
